description: Actual existing spatial GNSS/IMU fused trajectory with map constraint. Every tenth fused XY sample is reconstructed by tangent fillets for a coherent closed simulator geometry. The original complementary IMU curvature is not reused, so this is a trajectory approximation, not the original fused curvature solver or surveyed course. No raw personal paths or telemetry channels copied.
label: Fused GNSS/IMU trajectory — APPROXIMATION
